page.overview:
Who is Officer Jenny?

Officer Jenny is a police officer who lives in every city. They can be told apart only by Brock. She uses Growlithe and Arcanine as police dogs to search for thieves.

She and her cousins are friends and allies of Ash Ketchum and his Traveling companions when helping them against Teams Rocket, Aqua, Magma, Galactic, Plasma and Flare as well Poachers (including Hunter J).

Originally they had blue hair until when the animation changed to digital effects changing their hair green.

The Japanese name, Junsar, comes from (junsa), meaning "police officer", with a long vowel attached. The Jenny officers are often accompanied by Growlithe, to use as a police dog (although there are exceptions, like one had a Spinarak or where another has a Meganium, Parasect and Tangela or one that has the Squirtle Squad, etc.). There are some other minor differences between each of them, but not many as the Joys. The only differences are the symbols in their caps and uniforms (which are different depending on region). Unova Region Jennys have the back of their hair and their bangs cut.
